text:
kai: Quick payroll question — my relocation reimbursement paid 2025-06-05 was supposed to be grossed-up per my offer letter, but my June paystub shows the full amount taxed at the supplemental flat rate and no gross-up. Withheld federal ~$1,200. Can someone check?

jen-payroll: Thanks for flagging, Kai. Can you attach the offer letter clause that mentions gross-up? Also confirm whether the payment was labeled 'relocation' in Workday benefits.

kai: Attached offer excerpt and relocation approval email. Workday pay item says RELO-ONE-TIME. I see a line "Supplemental tax withholding" on the stub.

ryan-ops: We do intend to gross-up for approved relocation reimbursements >$1,000 per policy. Sounds like a pay-code mapping issue. I'll open payroll ticket.

jen-payroll: Creating ticket PR-4528. If provider withheld at flat supplemental rate, we can run a retro gross-up adjustment to reimburse the tax and net you the correct amount. Need offer letter and payroll ID (employee#) — got both.

payroll-bot: PR-4528 created by jen-payroll. Status: triage. Priority: medium. ETA for retro adj: next payroll window 2025-07-02.

tax-counsel: Quick note — gross-up is taxable income but treated as employer-paid tax. We'll calculate the gross-up amount required to net you original relocation benefit. Provide the exact gross amount and withheld taxes and we'll compute gross-up and necessary withholdings.

jen-payroll: Operational steps: 1) verify pay-code mapping (RELO-ONE-TIME should map to GROSSUP flag), 2) if mapping missing, request vendor adjustment and create adj run:
```
ADJ TYPE: grossup_correction
AMT: 3000.00
TAXES_REFUNDED: 1200.00
```
3) issue a supplemental payroll to reimburse withholding and apply gross-up. We'll post the calculation in PR-4528.

kai: Appreciate it. Will this affect my 2025 W-2?

jen-payroll: Yes — the gross-up and the original payment will both appear on the W-2 as wages. If we refund withheld taxes separately, we'll provide a payroll statement to help with tax prep. If the timing crosses tax years we may issue a W-2c.

ryan-ops: I've attached the mapping screenshot and flagged vendor. PR-4528 updated.

payroll-bot: PR-4528 update: vendor outreach sent. Next update expected 3-7 business days. Owner: jen-payroll.

kai: Thanks team — attaching offer again in thread for visibility. Happy to provide anything else. :thumbsup:
